method: Successfully read public Wayback id_ HTML; decoded gzip and used Python HTMLParser to extract static text without executing scripts. Only metadata and paraphrases retained.
observations: Acid Spray has a 0.2-second cast point and 0.7-second backswing, range 900 and duration 16.
One-second physical pulses start immediately and can total 17 over the field duration.
Its armor aura has a 0.5-second linger; the damage is independent of that aura.
Damage from overlapping sprays stacks, while armor reduction does not.
Existing damage keeps its cast level. Existing armor on already affected enemies does not update when the ability levels; newly affected enemies receive the new value.
